newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Manhattan Bagel cut to neutral. [CORRECTED 17:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Manhattan Bagel cut to neutral. [CORRECTED 17:45 GMT]

text.p: Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Monday it lowered its rating on Manhattan Bagel Co to neutral from buy and cut its 1997 earnings estimate to $0.18 from $0.20 and its 1998 estimate to $0.35 from $0.40.
-- Based on revised earnings, Manhattan Bagel is trading at a premium to other bagel restaurant companies, Rodman & Renshaw said in a research report.
-- "We believe that it needs to establish a record of uniterrupted earnings growth and execute its expansion plan to warrant a premium multiple," Rodman & Renshaw said.
(Corrects to add word "multiple" in above paragraph).
-- Manhattan Bagel shares were unchanged at 7-1/4 Monday.
